_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'Training Plan and Log' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.11.02.

f01_Target_Audience.label: Target Audience
f01_Target_Audience.guidance: The specific stakeholder group, department, or role that requires training to effectively operate new systems or execute updated workflows.

f02_Training_Module.label: Training Module
f02_Training_Module.guidance: The title, core learning objectives, and curriculum content designed to build required technical and operational competencies.

f03_Delivery_Method.label: Delivery Method
f03_Delivery_Method.guidance: The instructional format and medium used (e.g., in-person workshop, live virtual session, self-paced e-learning, or peer coaching).

f04_Target_Date.label: Target Date
f04_Target_Date.guidance: The scheduled delivery date or completion deadline, aligned with project deployment and user readiness milestones.

f05_Completion_Status.label: Completion Status
f05_Completion_Status.guidance: The current progress or adoption status (e.g., Scheduled, In Progress, Completed) tracking user participation and certification.
